svg.title: Issue 473 paired Mendelian AUPRC trajectories by region

cc:Work.dc:title: Issue 473 paired Mendelian AUPRC trajectories by region
cc:Work.dc:description: Four panels compare center-1 with full-window projection for CDS missense, splicing, and synonymous variants and enhancer distal variants on the development split.
